6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
7	
8	/-!
9	# The rank-one evaluation zero-locus comparison
10	
11	The canonical inverse is cut out by the evaluation counit, while the existing divisor engine
12	consumes the tied cocycle datum's local equations.  This file proves the section-level comparison
13	between those two descriptions before any Noetherian or regularity hypothesis is introduced.
14	
15	For a tied local presentation, transporting a datum section through `module_iso.inv` commutes
16	with restriction to every open.  Since every component of the sheaf isomorphism is injective,
17	restriction vanishes on the module side exactly when it vanishes on the datum side.  Applying
18	this to the canonical unit-lift through the evaluation counit identifies its restriction-
19	vanishing predicate with that of `datumSection`.  The final theorem specializes the comparison
20	to `PicRankOneNativePresentation`, whose converted module is definitionally the native module.
21	
22	The second half passes to the canonical `O_X`-linear piece trivializations of the native module.
23	It proves that the evaluated section has coordinate `datum.component` on every cocycle piece, and
24	hence that the two principal local ideals agree.  This closes the local equation comparison, but
25	does not yet glue those ideals into a base-change-compatible family-level evaluation divisor.  The
26	file also does not assert regularity or manufacture the still-missing arbitrary-affine presentation
27	producer.
28	-/
29	
30	set_option autoImplicit false
31	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
32	
33	universe u
34	
35	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
36	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
37	
38	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
39	
40	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
41	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
42	
43	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
44	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
45	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
46	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
47	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
48	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
49	
50	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
51	
52	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
53	
54	/-- The coordinate of a native global section on one cocycle piece.
55	
56	This is obtained by restricting the section to `D.pieces j` and applying the canonical
57	`O_X`-linear trivialization of the native module there. -/
58	noncomputable def nativePieceCoordinate
59	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
60	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
61	    (j : D.index) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
62	  gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j le_rfl
63	    (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
64	      (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) s)
65	
66	/-- The native coordinate is the datum component of the same global section. -/
67	theorem nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
68	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
69	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
70	    (j : D.index) :
71	    D.nativePieceCoordinate s j = D.component s j := by
72	  rw [nativePieceCoordinate, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
73	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
74	
75	/-- Native piece coordinates commute with arbitrary affine coefficient extension. -/
76	theorem nativePieceCoordinate_sectionsMapTop
77	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
78	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
79	    [IsScalarTower k B B']
80	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
81	    (j : D.index) :
82	    (D.baseChange B').nativePieceCoordinate (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j =
83	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j (D.nativePieceCoordinate s j) := by
84	  rw [(D.baseChange B').nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component,
85	    D.component_sectionsMapTop, D.nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component]
86	
87	/-- The principal native-coordinate ideal is preserved by arbitrary affine coefficient
88	extension. This is the ideal-level consumer of `nativePieceCoordinate_sectionsMapTop`. -/
89	theorem nativePieceIdeal_sectionsMapTop
90	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
91	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
92	    [IsScalarTower k B B']
93	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
94	    (j : D.index) :
95	    Ideal.map (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j)
96	        (Ideal.span {D.nativePieceCoordinate s j}) =
97	      Ideal.span {
98	        (D.baseChange B').nativePieceCoordinate (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j} := by
99	  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, D.nativePieceCoordinate_sectionsMapTop]
100	
101	/-- The inverse of the native base-ring section equivalence is the identity on underlying
102	sections. -/
103	@[simp]
104	theorem nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv_symm_apply
105	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
106	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
107	    (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).symm s = s := by
108	  apply (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).injective
109	  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
110	  rfl
111	
112	/-- The inverse component of the native base-ring sheaf isomorphism is the identity on
113	underlying sections. -/
114	@[simp]
115	theorem nativeModuleKSheafIso_inv_app
116	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
117	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
118	    (D.nativeModuleKSheafIso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s = s := by
119	  change (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).symm s = s
120	  exact D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv_symm_apply U s
121	
122	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
123	
124	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
125	
126	/-- Transport through the tied sheaf isomorphism commutes with restriction on sections. -/
127	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict
128	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
129	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
130	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
131	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
132	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
133	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
134	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s)) =
135	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V)).hom
136	        ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s) := by
137	  exact congrArg (fun z => z.hom s)
138	    (P.module_iso.inv.hom.naturality (homOfLE h).op).symm
139	
140	/-- Restriction vanishes after transport to the base-ring module exactly when the datum restriction
141	vanishes.  This is a pointwise section comparison supplied by `module_iso`; it is not a statement
142	about the native `O_X`-module ideal and needs no Noetherian hypothesis. -/
143	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff
144	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
145	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
146	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
147	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
148	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
149	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
150	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s) = 0) ↔
151	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s = 0) := by
152	  rw [P.module_iso_inv_restrict h s]
153	  exact map_eq_zero_iff _
154	    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
155	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V))).1
156	
157	/-- The evaluation counit sends the canonical H⁰ unit-lift to the module section obtained
158	from the tied datum class. -/
159	theorem evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv
160	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
161	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
162	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
163	      ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
164	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
165	      (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := by
166	  calc
167	    _ = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
168	    _ = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := rfl
169	
170	/-- The canonical evaluation section and the tied datum section have the same restriction-
171	vanishing predicate on every open of the relative curve.
172	
173	This is the immediate consumer of `module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff`: the evaluated section
174	is first identified with `moduleSectionsEquiv y`, then with the inverse image of
175	`datumSection y` under the presentation's sheaf isomorphism. -/
176	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
177	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
178	    {V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
179	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
180	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
181	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
182	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
183	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
184	        ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
185	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
186	        (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
187	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
188	        (P.datumSection y) = 0) := by
189	  rw [P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
190	  rw [← P.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
191	  exact P.module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff h (P.datumSection y)
192	
193	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
194	
195	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
196	
197	/-- Native specialization of the evaluation/datum zero-locus comparison.
198	
199	`toLocalPresentation.module` is definitionally `P.datum.nativeModule`, so this theorem is the
200	consumer-facing native base-ring section comparison rather than a second choice of line bundle.
201	The native `O_X`-linear ideal comparison remains a separate producer obligation. -/
202	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
203	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
204	    {V : (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
205	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0) :
206	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
207	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
208	        Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)))
209	        P.toLocalPresentation.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
210	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
211	        ((relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
212	          Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
213	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
214	        (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
215	      ((P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
216	        (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) = 0) := by
217	  exact P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff h y
218	
219	/-- Under the native trivialization, the section attached to a datum `H⁰` class has the datum's
220	component as its coordinate on every cocycle piece. -/
221	theorem moduleSectionsEquiv_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
222	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
223	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
224	    (j : P.datum.index) :
225	    P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate (P.toLocalPresentation.moduleSectionsEquiv y) j =
226	      P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j := by
227	  rw [← P.toLocalPresentation.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
228	  change P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
229	      ((P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso.inv.hom.app
230	        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens))).hom
231	          (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y)) j = _
232	  rw [P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso_inv_app]
233	  exact P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component _ j
234	
235	/-- The canonical evaluation counit section has `datum.component` as its coordinate under the
236	native `O_X`-linear trivialization on every cocycle piece. -/
237	theorem evaluationLift_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
238	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
239	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
240	    (j : P.datum.index) :
241	    P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
242	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
243	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
244	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
245	          (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) j =
246	      P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j := by
247	  rw [P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
248	  exact P.moduleSectionsEquiv_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component y j
249	
250	/-- The principal ideal cut out by the native evaluation section on a cocycle piece is exactly
251	the principal ideal generated by the datum component consumed by the divisor engine. -/
252	theorem evaluationLift_nativePieceIdeal_eq_componentIdeal
253	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
254	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
255	    (j : P.datum.index) :
256	    Ideal.span {P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
257	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
258	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
259	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
260	          (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) j} =
261	      Ideal.span {P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j} := by
262	  rw [P.evaluationLift_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component y j]
263	
264	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
265	
266	end AlgebraicGeometry
